title: Adjoining free extreme arrows to a directed coherent algebroid
statement:
Use the universes and coherent algebroids of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], the fixed-object category $\mathcal A_S$, forgetful functor $V_S$ and free functor $G_S$ of [lem-coef-categorical-algebra-free-monad], and coherent colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal V$ be presentably monoidal and $S=S_0\amalg S_1\amalg S_2$ a small partition. Let $A\in\mathcal A_S$ satisfy $\mathbf1\xrightarrow{\sim}A(s,s)$ for every $s$, and $A(s,t)\simeq0_{\mathcal V}$ for distinct $s,t$ except when $s\in S_i,t\in S_j$ with $i<j$. Let $P\in\mathcal V^{S\times S}$ be initial off $S_0\times S_2$. Form the coproduct $C=A\amalg G_SP$ in $\mathcal A_S$. There is a canonical graph map
$$e_{A,P}:V_SA\amalg P\longrightarrow V_SC$$
whose restrictions are the underlying coproduct inclusion $A\to C$ and the free-generator map $P\to V_SG_SP\to V_SC$. This map is an equivalence in $\mathcal V^{S\times S}$.

This is the canonical equivalence with these summand maps, coherently natural in $A,P$ and in relabelings preserving the partition. It is compatible with substitution of generators into algebra mapping objects: for any $D\in\mathcal A_S$, any algebra map $a:A\to D$ and graph map $v:P\to V_SD$, the induced algebra map $\phi:A\amalg G_SP\to D$ satisfies $V_S\phi\circ e_{A,P}\simeq[V_Sa,v]$. This identity holds as a natural transformation on the full mapping spaces of pairs $(a,v)$, including all higher homotopies and composition of substitutions. In particular it applies to $D=A'\amalg G_SP'$ and maps sending a generator either into the $A'$ summand or into a $P'$ summand. No relation $Q\to P$ or amalgamated pushout is part of this assertion.

These do not state this coproduct calculation verbatim. Supporting counit-bar construction: Higher Algebra, Example 4.7.2.7 and Proposition 4.7.3.14. Sources read online; archival copies WANTED.
